lessons_learned.lesson: Wave 2 resolved every Wave 1 'remaining work' item except low-severity per-file date fields in SRC-*.json and 2 legacy date_added fields in api-tools.
lessons_learned.evidence: 9/9 Wave 1 remaining items addressed. Quality gate went from 44.9% to 98.4%.

lessons_learned.lesson: Expanding validation scope reveals true health. Wave 1's 167 checks understated the problem; Wave 2's 2580 checks give accurate coverage.
lessons_learned.evidence: 2580 checks caught 41 failures that 167 checks would have missed entirely (per-file SRC date fields).

lessons_learned.lesson: Import path and API signature mismatches are the #1 integration risk when teams build concurrently.
lessons_learned.evidence: TEAM-G's entire mission was reconciling import paths and constructor signatures between Wave 1 teams.

lessons_learned.lesson: Backwards-compatible optional parameters are the safest migration pattern for shared infrastructure.
lessons_learned.evidence: TEAM-I integrated PartitionedStore into coordinator_hub and help_protocol with zero breaking changes.

lessons_learned.lesson: Automated date normalization works for flat JSON but misses nested structures. Manual intervention still needed for arrays-of-objects.
lessons_learned.evidence: TEAM-H had to write manual scripts for hub/infrastructure-inventory.json (42 nested entries).

lessons_learned.lesson: Duplicate merging requires human judgment on which version to keep. Tooling identifies candidates but cannot auto-merge safely.
lessons_learned.evidence: TEAM-H manually inspected KB-0012/KB-0013 overlap before merging (95% content overlap confirmed).
